name: Motion-graphic explainer (Kurzgesagt-style)
description: For animated, narration-timed explainers. It keeps the narration pacing untouched (no cuts), and adds a title, one stat callout and an end card. The illustrated look itself comes from your animation; score and sound effects are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

cleanup.reason: the narration sets the pace of the animation, so pauses are kept

beats.name: Visual hook
beats.guidance: Open on a visual metaphor and a big number.

beats.name: Explanation
beats.guidance: Animate each idea as the narrator says it.

beats.name: Scale moment
beats.guidance: Show the size or time scale in one image.

beats.name: Takeaway and sources
beats.guidance: State the takeaway; show where the facts come from.

deferred.title: Composed score and sound effects
deferred.description: A music score and sound effects for mood.

deferred.title: Illustrations and infographics
deferred.description: Flat vector artwork and infographic overlays.

deferred.title: Animated camera moves
deferred.description: Drawn camera moves instead of punch-ins.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Use your own artwork or properly licensed illustrations; do not copy another studio's characters or style assets.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
